claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for the current release, but only on a qualified basis tied to explicit current-release disclosure of the legal intake limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A conditional rationale is not enough unless the condition itself is evidenced in the admissible record.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or release thread text showing explicit disclosure of the legal intake limitation.
Provide any approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the documented subgroup regression for the named launch use case.
Provide the current evaluation artifact showing the subgroup regression and whether it is classified as a material limitation under internal review.
Provide the final model-card or certification packet version for this release reflecting current evaluation results.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or include approved mitigation, but the available summary says no disclosure language or approved mitigation is attached in the release thread.
The Actor's recommended action is certification, while the admissible support described is only conditional on a disclosure step that is not itself evidenced.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are expressly contextual only under both the policy text and the Actor's own summary, so they cannot close the current-release support gap.
A named launch use case has a documented subgroup regression below the warning threshold, which makes the missing disclosure or approved acceptance a material unresolved predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supported for the current release on the evidence provided.
That the required current-release documentation/disclosure condition has been satisfied.
That contextual prior approval or informal monitoring can materially support the certification decision beyond background context.
